question.question_text: What were the prerequisite steps followed by the camera wearer to adjust and fix the electric terminal block?

answer_options.text: Pick and straighten cables with pliers, adjust plastic pieces within the block, use a Phillips screwdriver to fix cables and screws
Adjust metal pieces within the block, use a flat screwdriver to fix cables and screws
Pick and fold cables with hands, adjust metal pieces within the block, use a torque wrench to secure cables and screws
Pick and fold cables with pliers, adjust metal pieces within the block, use a flat screwdriver to fix cables and screws, then test with a multimeter
